title: Severity vs Priority — Overview
summary: Severity is technical impact; priority is business urgency — set them independently.
body:
Severity is technical impact; priority is business urgency — set them independently. Standard defect classification.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include Bug Triage, SLA, Defect Metrics.
